程序包 org.bukkit.metadata

类 MetadataStoreBase<T>

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.metadata.MetadataStoreBase<T>
@Deprecated public abstract class MetadataStoreBase<T> extends java.lang.Object
已过时。
This system is extremely misleading and does not cleanup values for metadatable entities that have been removed. It is recommended that when wanting persistent metadata, you use PersistentDataContainer.

If you want temporary values on an entity, use the entity lifecycle events and a Map of your own. (See EntityAddToWorldEvent and EntityRemoveFromWorldEvent)

    • setMetadata

      public void setMetadata(@NotNull T subject, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String metadataKey, @NotNull @NotNull MetadataValue newMetadataValue)
      已过时。
      向对象添加元数据值. 每个元数据值由特定Plugin拥有. 如果插件已经向对象添加了元数据值, 该值将被newMetadataValue的值替换. 多个插件可以为相同的metadataKey设置独立的值而不会冲突.

      实现说明：我考虑使用ReadWriteLock来控制对metadataMap的访问, 但认为增加的开销不值得更细粒度的访问控制.

      Bukkit几乎完全是单线程的, 所以锁定开销应该不会造成问题.

      原文： Adds a metadata value to an object. Each metadata value is owned by a specific Plugin. If a plugin has already added a metadata value to an object, that value will be replaced with the value of newMetadataValue. Multiple plugins can set independent values for the same metadataKey without conflict.

      Implementation note: I considered using a ReadWriteLock for controlling access to metadataMap, but decided that the added overhead wasn't worth the finer grained access control.

      Bukkit is almost entirely single threaded so locking overhead shouldn't pose a problem.

      参数:
      subject - 接收元数据的对象.

      原文：The object receiving the metadata.

      metadataKey - 用于标识此元数据的唯一键.

      原文：A unique key to identify this metadata.

      newMetadataValue - 要应用的元数据值.

      原文：The metadata value to apply.

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果值为null, 或拥有插件为null

      原文：If value is null, or the owning plugin is null

      另请参阅:
      • MetadataStore.setMetadata(Object, String, MetadataValue)

      原文：A list of values, one for each plugin that has set the requested value.

    • invalidateAll

      public void invalidateAll(@NotNull @NotNull Plugin owningPlugin)
      已过时。
      使元数据存储中所有来自指定插件的元数据失效. 这样做将强制每个失效的元数据项在下次被访问时重新计算.

      原文： Invalidates all metadata in the metadata store that originates from the given plugin. Doing this will force each invalidated metadata item to be recalculated the next time it is accessed.

      参数:
      owningPlugin - 请求失效的插件.

      原文：the plugin requesting the invalidation.

      抛出:
      java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - 如果插件为null

      原文：If plugin is null

      另请参阅:
      • MetadataStore.invalidateAll(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin)

    • disambiguate

      @NotNull protected abstract @NotNull java.lang.String disambiguate(@NotNull T subject, @NotNull @NotNull java.lang.String metadataKey)
      已过时。
      通过组合对象的唯一数据和metadataKey, 为接收元数据的对象创建唯一名称.

      创建的名称对于给定对象必须是全局唯一的, 任何两个等价的对象必须生成相同的唯一名称. 例如, 如果两个Player对象代表同一个玩家, 即使这两个对象无法通过引用相等性测试, 它们也必须生成相同的字符串.

      原文： Creates a unique name for the object receiving metadata by combining unique data from the subject with a metadataKey.

      The name created must be globally unique for the given object and any two equivalent objects must generate the same unique name. For example, two Player objects must generate the same string if they represent the same player, even if the objects would fail a reference equality test.

      参数:
      subject - 为此对象生成键.

      原文：The object for which this key is being generated.

      metadataKey - 标识元数据值的名称.

      原文：The name identifying the metadata value.

      返回:
      给定对象的唯一元数据键.

      原文：a unique metadata key for the given subject.
